verdict.rationale: Clerky offers a catalog of standardized startup paperwork products that founders fill in themselves: safes, convertible notes, hiring documents for employees, consultants and advisors, stock plans, and a post-formation legal dashboard. Founders can customize key terms, and the underlying forms can be swapped out. A community user says it saved them thousands compared with paying for legal work. However, the evidence covers formation, equity, financing and hiring documents rather than a general template library. missing for 10: explicit NDA and policy templates, evidence that the templates are attorney-vetted, a browsable general-purpose template library beyond startup equity, financing and hiring documents, independent hands-on corroboration of template breadth.
